name: io.github.fortuneflick/agentisend
title: AgentiSend
description: AgentiSend is a transactional email API for AI agents: send receipts, password resets, sign-in codes and alerts from your own verified domain, with a message log, spend budgets, a free preflight and refusals that name the fix. The hosted MCP server at https://api.agentisend.com/mcp exposes 84 tools (44 on tools/list; the rest via list_more_tools) for sending, domain setup, templates, contacts, broadcasts, webhooks and delivery logs. A send is one message or a batch of up to 500 items with per-item results. preflight_email runs every gate a real send runs, sends nothing, and costs nothing. Every refusal returns a code, a message and the fix. A loop guard holds repeated sends for a person. You can cap what each agent spends, and stop all sending with a kill switch. There is no tool for unsolicited mail. Sign in with OAuth 2.1 and dynamic client registration, or use an API key. Starter prompts: "Send this receipt to the customer." "Preflight this send and tell me what would stop it." "What can I spend today?"

environmentVariables.name: AGENTISEND_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your AgentiSend API key. Read from the environment only, never passed as an argument, because process arguments are visible to every other process on the machine.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTISEND_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: The hosted endpoint this launcher proxies to. Defaults to https://api.agentisend.com/mcp.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your API key>. OAuth 2.1 reaches the same tools with the same ceilings.
